{"kind":"command","command_call":{"command":"CMD_PLD_SET_STATE","parameters":{"state":"OFF"}},"escalation":null,"rationale":"EPS_LOAD_I transitioned to YELLOW_HIGH at MET 900 from 1.400 A to 1.800 A with EPS_SA1_I/EPS_SA2_I remaining nominal at 1.7 A each and ADM_ECLIPSE SUNLIT, indicating a load excursion / stuck load. CMD_PLD_SET_STATE is C1 raised to C4 by the breached envelope limit; lease L-SHED covers state OFF with conditions satisfied and uses remaining."}
